What the corporate site does show (self-declared, not independent evidence): JCBL Limited, JCBL Group, corporate office Plot 580, Phase 9, Industrial Area, Sector 66, Mohali-160062, Punjab; works at Lalru (Mohali, Punjab) and via JCBL Marrel Tippers Pvt Ltd at Oragadam, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu; founded 1989; bus/coach building, special application vehicles, ambulances, tippers/trailers, caravans. No Russia/CIS counterparty, contract or shipment appears anywhere on the site — but absence on a marketing site is not proof of absence. No negative news, litigation or regulator action found in the material actually read; that is a coverage gap, not a clean bill. Chairman named as Rajinder Aggarwal (Dec 2023 interview), director 'Babbar' (Deccan Herald, Sep 2023) — ownership/UBO not verified. Per project rules, sanctions/court/criminal matters are never rejection grounds; company stays in the base. Recommend re-run of sanctions and court checks (OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS lists, eCourts/NCLT, Punjab & Haryana HC) when search access is restored.
